proposals.current_pain_description: If a GHA workflow gets stuck in an infinite loop or runs too frequently, a PAYG key like Runware can consume the entire 20€ monthly budget in minutes, halting all image production for the month.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight state file (`.github/api_budget_state.json`) updated via Git commit/cache. Before any paid API call, check if the daily/monthly limit (e.g., $0.66/day) is exceeded. If so, fail gracefully or fallback to free Pollinations.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 100% of financial risk; prevents sudden interruptions in development budget.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo only has 10 hours/week and works via phone. If a GitHub Action fails (rate limits, API changes), he has to manually navigate to GitHub to check, losing valuable reaction time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-failure step in all GHA workflows that sends a concise markdown payload (error message, log link) to a free Telegram Bot or Discord Webhook directly to Hugo's phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 1-2 hours of manual monitoring per week; instant feedback loop on mobile.

proposals.issue_title: Unfiltered Low-Quality AI Images (Gibberish and Grayscale)
proposals.current_pain_description: Free or fast generators (Pollinations, Together FLUX-schnell) often output artifacts, grayscale shading instead of pure line art, or distorted lines that make coloring books unsellable.
proposals.proposed_fix: Leverage Gemini 2.5 Flash's free multimodal API inside `agent_gemini_quality_check`. Pass the generated image with a strict prompt: 'Is this clean black-and-white line art with NO gray shading, NO text, and NO anatomical errors? Answer YES/NO'. Discard NO outputs.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures 100% sellable quality; prevents KDP account termination due to low-quality customer reviews.

proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo has zero active platforms live. Uploading multiple loose images, tags, and descriptions from a Termux/Android phone to KDP or Etsy is extremely slow and tedious.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create an automation step that compiles assets into a single ZIP file containing: the optimized PDF/PNG, a pre-formatted TXT file with (Title, Description, Tags, Price), and a thumbnail. Push this directly to a private GitHub Release. Hugo only downloads one ZIP per product to his phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual listing time from 20 mins to 3 mins per product on mobile.

proposals.issue_title: Redundant Trend-Hunting Agents Wasting API Quotas
proposals.current_pain_description: Four separate agents perform similar web scraping or LLM trend analysis. This duplicates code, slows execution, and risks hitting Gemini API rate limits (429).
proposals.proposed_fix: Consolidate the scraping and analysis logic into a single unified `agent_trend_consolidator`. Let it write a single schema-validated `trends_today.json` that other production pipelines read as a single source of truth.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces API call volume by 60%; simplifies pipeline maintenance.

proposals.issue_title: Missed Cross-Pollination of Coloring Designs to SVG/POD
proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality vector/line art generated for coloring books is discarded after compilation, missing opportunities for digital SVG packs (Etsy) or transparent PNGs (Redbubble).
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-generation script to `produce_coloring_book` that extracts individual high-quality pages, converts them to SVG (via potrace/vectorization utilities in GHA), and auto-stages them in the `produce_svg_pack` output folder.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Doubles the product output per hour of GPU generation; expands catalog footprint automatically.
